status.nb: 27 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Damaskus, Aleppo og Quneitra.

summary.en: Syrian security forces arrested the main suspect in the 2013 Baniyas massacre and sentenced two individuals to death for the 2025 coastal sectarian violence, while another pair received death sentences for related clashes. A gas export pipeline in northeastern Syria was attacked, causing a fire, and Syrian intelligence detained a militia leader linked to the 2013 Baniyas massacre. Qatar and Syria’s interior ministries deepened security cooperation in Damascus, and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu disclosed direct contact with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa regarding the Druze community. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker arresterte hovedmistenkte i Baniyas-massakren i 2013 og dømte to personer til døden for den sekteriske volden langs kysten i 2025, mens et annet par fikk dødsstraff for tilknyttede sammenstøt. En gasseksportpipeline i nordøstlige Syria ble angrepet, noe som førte til brann, og syrisk etterretning fengslet en militsleder knyttet til Baniyas-massakren i 2013. Qatar og Syriens innenriksdepartement styrket sikkerhetssamarbeidet i Damaskus, og Israels statsminister Netanyahu opplyste om direkte kontakt med Syriens president Ahmed al-Sharaa angående drus-samfunnet. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
